title: Corpus search for subreport detail rows design — comprehensive findings
body:
Corpus search completed for "subreport detail rows" feature design task. Findings:

ARTIFACT STATE:
- ADRs: 0 exist (entire corpus)
- ASRs: 0 exist
- Design docs: 2 exist (DD-preact-rebuild-architecture.md, CONTRACTS.md) — both about preact rebuild, not subreport features
- Plans: 7 completed plans (TASK-preact-A through F) — all about preact rebuild
- Logs: 43 entries from preact rebuild (June 12-13, 2026)

KEY ARCHITECTURAL CONSTRAINTS (from CONTRACTS.md + logs):
1. ResultSet shape: {columns: string[], rows: Record<string,unknown>[], metadata} — fully homogeneous, all rows share same column set
2. _row_type marker column exists for subtotals: 0=detail, 1=subtotal, 2=spacer, 3=grand total
3. Subtotals builder (sql-subtotals.ts) uses UNION ALL with band tagging (_row_type, _sort_row_type, _sort_group_N) — closest existing pattern to subreport detail rows
4. No concept of "child queries" exists — all queries operate on single base table with JOINs
5. Engine uses buildQueryPlan() as orchestrator, dispatches to sql-detail/sql-grouped/sql-totals/sql-subtotals
6. Export is single-sheet XLSX or CSV, no multi-sheet support
7. Lookup mechanism: LookupSpec interface with rightId, keyPairs, cols, required, enabled, duplicatePolicy
8. LookupStage UI component exists for configuring joins
9. Five-layer architecture: core → catalog → query → report → UI

GAPS IDENTIFIED:
- No ADRs for report engine architecture, query builder patterns, or result set shape conventions
- All institutional knowledge lives in agent execution logs
- Biggest architectural gap: ResultSet assumes homogeneous columns; supporting heterogeneous rows (each row with own column set + band ID) would require changes to ResultSet, grid renderer, and export formatter

RELEVANT LOGS:
- support-researcher L1: Thorough 5-layer analysis (HIGH relevance)
- exec-executor L34: Calc column gap in detail queries — resolveRef() returns quoted alias, not computed SQL (HIGH)
- exec-executor L12: Engine architecture — single query plan, no multi-band support (HIGH)
- exec-executor L27: stack-sheets.tsx is existing UNION ALL precedent (MEDIUM)
- exec-executor L29: Export system in ui/export.ts (MEDIUM)

CONCLUSION: This is a greenfield feature with no prior architectural decisions recorded. The subtotals UNION ALL pattern is the closest precedent. Design must address: (1) heterogeneous result set shape, (2) child query orchestration, (3) multi-band export formatting, (4) UI for configuring detail bands.

title: Artifact corpus search for Preact-to-React conversion
body: Searched entire artifact corpus for Preact-to-React conversion context. Key findings: (1) No ADR explicitly justifies Preact vs React — framework choice is inherited from rebuild design doc without formal decision. (2) ADR-007 proposes Preact signals migration — incompatible direction if moving to React. (3) DD-pivot-table-ui-redesign (pending) is a major UI-layer rewrite already in planning — creates sequencing risk. (4) No ADRs about build tooling, theming, or styling approach exist. (5) Store is a custom pub/sub (116 lines) — framework-agnostic, compatible with React hooks. (6) The npm run dev uses tsc --watch, not Vite HMR — build pipeline needs rework for React.

title: Live Chip-Table context search — critical discovery: React+MUI conversion already live
body: Full artifact corpus search for Live Chip-Table UI design context. Critical discovery: the React+MUI+Vite+AG Grid React conversion (DD-preact-to-react-conversion) has ALREADY been fully executed. The codebase uses react 19, @mui/material 7, ag-grid-react 33, vite 6 with @vitejs/plugin-react. No Preact dependencies remain. All three pivot/design-related DDs are either stale (conversion DD describes completed work) or contain invalid constraints (old Preact pivot DD says delete AG Grid; stub React pivot DD says wait for conversion then delete AG Grid). Both are wrong — AG Grid React IS the grid. The old pivot DD's design thinking (3-zone drop zones, auto-preview, _ui field, column palette DnD) transfers to React+AG Grid React. Header components in grid.tsx still need migration from class-based _makeHeaderComponent to React FCs via headerComponentFramework — this is the main unfinished item.

title: Dual five-layer ADRs found — ADR-002 (Accepted) and ADR-004 (Proposed)
body: ADR-002 (Five-Layer Architecture, Accepted) and ADR-004 (Five-Layer Architecture, Proposed) both document the same structure. ADR-004 adds a "New code placement heuristic" not present in ADR-002. Both reference the Preact UI layer — neither has been updated for the React+MUI conversion. ADR-004 should either be superseded (if ADR-002 is sufficient) or accepted (if the heuristic is useful). Either way, both need UI layer descriptions updated from "Preact component tree" to "React component tree". Identified during Live Chip-Table context search.
